messages:
lee_t: Heads-up: preflight prompt-eval for summarizer-v3.2.1 flagged a regression on our gated prompt set (policy-extract). deploybot posted the summary.

deploybot: preflight-eval FAILED — delta_embed_quality: -4.8% (threshold -2%), failing_samples 9/150. details: https://redwood.internal/evals/1299 :rotating_light:

maria: is this new behavior for v3.2.* or only 3.2.1? any route-specific signals?

deploybot: failure first observed in v3.2.1 rollout test. Affects default and summarizer-long routes.

qa_ben: quick glance: outputs are shorter and missing policy bullets. likely related to attention window handling for long-doc inputs.

product_anya: User-facing regression. Suggest either (1) pin default route to v3.2.0 and let 3.2.1 soak in canary while we triage, or (2) deploy a temporary config fallback that forces longer context handling using the older kv-cache behavior. Thoughts?

ops_sam: For safety, I'd prefer pin+staged-redeploy after fix. Pin command ready:
```
# pin route to previous stable
deploybot pin --route summarizer-default --version summarizer-v3.2.0 --reason "preflight eval regression"
```
If product wants an immediate workaround, we can push the kv-cache fallback as a hotfix, but that needs canary validation.

maria: triage update: A/B test between v3.2.1 float and quant shows float passes eval thresholds. Quantized artifact is the regressed one.

lee_t: OK that narrows it. Product, what's preferred? Float fallback will increase cost but keeps features live. Pin will delay features.

product_anya: Float fallback for canary only, please. We'll pin default route for now, and re-evaluate after quant fix. Need release note entry that we temporarily disabled quant rollout.

ops_sam: Doing both: pin default -> summarizer-v3.2.0, schedule canary float promotion for 03-23 01:00 UTC at 5%. Abort conditions: mean_delta <= -2% or any customer-facing errors. I'll set monitors and alerts to #incidents and page if triggered.

qa_ben: I'll extend the prompt-suite with extra long-doc tests and kick off a validation run once canary spins up.

deploybot: scheduled pin and canary float job created (job-id jb-7812). Will post stage updates in this thread.

lee_t: Thanks. Once canary completes and QA signs off, update the release metadata and changelog snippet (PR link please).

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/987 — notes mention "temporary float fallback for quant regression on long-doc summarization".

product_anya: Approved. :white_check_mark: Keep me posted on QA results.

ops_sam: Roger. Aborting if eval delta > 3% or error_rate > 1%.

lee_t: Closing loop for now. If any surprise alerts, ping @ops_sam and we'll roll forward/rollback as needed. :thumbsup:
